name: Wall Push-Up
steps: Stand facing a flat wall about an arm's length away, with feet hip-width apart.
Place your palms flat against the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your body in a straight line from heels to head, bend your elbows and slowly lower your chest toward the wall.
Pause when your nose or chest is an inch or two from the wall.
Push steadily through your palms to return to the starting upright position.
coaching_cues: To make it easier, stand closer to the wall; to make it more challenging, step your feet further back.
Keep your core lightly engaged so your hips do not sag or stick out.
Keep elbows angled down at 45 degrees rather than high near your ears.

sources.attribution: NIH National Institute on Aging Exercise Protocols
